tshechu.title: Tshechu Festival & Sacred Cham Dances
tshechu.subtitle: Monastic Rituals Masked Cham Dances & Himalayan Culture
tshechu.overview: This 14 day photography journey is dedicated to documenting the sacred Tshechu festival at Shechen Monastery and major Tibetan Buddhist sanctuaries across the Kathmandu Valley and Himalayan foothills. Tshechu is a celebration of spiritual transformation honoring Guru Rinpoche (Padmasambhava). Over 2 intensive days at the monastery, they photographed Buddhist monks performing ancient Cham dances in elaborate brocade robes and hand carved deity masks to the resonant sound of dungchen trumpets, cymbals and drums. Beyond the monastic courtyards capture the timeless devotions at Boudhanath and Swayambhunath stupas traditional Newar architecture in Bandipur and stunning Himalayan sunrise views over Annapurna ranges.

highlights.title: Shechen Monastery Cham Dances
highlights.description: Photograph 3 days of sacred masked Cham dances performed by monks in intricate brocade robes and deity masks.

highlights.title: Sacred Silk Thangka Display
highlights.description: Document the dramatic morning unveiling of monumental silk thangkas in the monastery courtyard.

highlights.title: Monastic Ritual Music & Prayers
highlights.description: Capture low light portraits of senior lamas and young novices sounding dungchen trumpets and ritual drums.

highlights.title: Boudhanath & Swayambhunath Stupas
highlights.description: Document pilgrims spinning prayer wheels and performing morning kora around ancient stupas.

highlights.title: Bandipur Newar Architecture
highlights.description: Photograph preserved 18th century Newari wooden balconies and quiet cobblestone streets.

highlights.title: Himalayan Sunrise at Ghandruk
highlights.description: Capture golden light on Mount Machhapuchhre (Fishtail) and Annapurna South from traditional Gurung stone villages.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kathmandu Hotel Check In & Expedition Briefing
itinerary.description: Upon landing at Tribhuvan International Airport in Kathmandu our representative warmly greets you and arranges a private transfer to your boutique hotel. Use the morning to rest, unpack camera gear and acclimatize to the local tempo. In the late afternoon enjoy an introductory photo walk through the vibrant alleyways of Thamel focusing on ambient street light market textures and local portraits. In the evening gather for a welcome dinner and comprehensive photography briefing detailing monastery protocol lighting conditions and equipment recommendations for the upcoming Tshechu festival.

itinerary.title: Swayambhunath and Patan Durbar Square
itinerary.description: Start your morning at hilltop Swayambhunath Stupa, marveling at the ancient stupa, prayer flags, and panoramic views of Kathmandu Valley. Afterward, travel to Patan Durbar Square in Lalitpur. Admire exquisite Newari craftsmanship, woodcarvings, and iconic stone temples like Krishna Mandir. Stroll through courtyard art galleries and bustling local markets before returning to your hotel.

itinerary.title: Tsechu Preparation at Shechen Monastery
itinerary.description: Spend the day at Shechen Monastery near Boudhanath, observing the anticipation and spiritual energy leading up to Tsechu. Watch Buddhist monks conduct preliminary prayers, refine ritualistic steps, and put finishing touches on colorful masks and sacred costumes. Engage in quiet reflection within the tranquil courtyard as local devotees gather, creating a serene, reverent atmosphere ahead of the grand festival.

itinerary.title: The Big Day of Tsechu Festival
itinerary.description: Experience the full-day Tsechu celebration in the courtyard of Shechen Monastery. Witness the sacred cham masked dances performed by monks, honoring Guru Rinpoche through intricate choreography, symbolic music, and spiritual storytelling. Joining high-ranking lamas, dignitaries, and crowds of devotees, immerse yourself in this deeply moving Himalayan Buddhist ritual commemorating ancient spiritual traditions.

itinerary.title: Drive to Chitwan
itinerary.description: Depart Kathmandu for a scenic overland journey following winding river valleys toward Chitwan National Park. As you descend into the subtropical Terai plains, watch the mountain landscape give way to lush forests and Tharu villages. Arrive at your jungle lodge, check in, and enjoy a peaceful evening walk along the Rapti River to catch a memorable sunset.

itinerary.title: Full Day Jungle Safari
itinerary.description: Spend the day exploring Chitwan National Park. Board a jeep safari or canoe along the Rapti River to spot rare wildlife, including one-horned rhinoceroses, gharial crocodiles, wild elephants, and diverse bird species. Accompanied by experienced nature guides, gain insight into jungle conservation efforts and conclude the evening with a traditional Tharu cultural dance performance.

itinerary.title: Drive to Pokhara
itinerary.description: Leave Chitwan behind and drive west along scenic highway routes toward Pokhara. Arrive in the lakeside city, situated at the base of the majestic Annapurna mountain range. Check into your hotel and spend the afternoon unwinding along the shores of Phewa Lake, enjoying fresh mountain breezes, cozy cafes, and picturesque views of Machhapuchhre peak reflected in the water.

itinerary.title: Drive to Ghandruk Village
itinerary.description: Take a picturesque drive from Pokhara into the Annapurna foothills to reach Ghandruk, a traditional Gurung mountain village. Walk along slate-paved alleyways past stone houses and terraced fields. Immerse yourself in local culture, visit the local heritage museum, and enjoy close-up panoramic views of Annapurna South, Hiunchuli, and Fishtail peaks.

itinerary.title: Drive Back to Pokhara and Leisure Time
itinerary.description: Enjoy a tranquil morning in Ghandruk taking in the crisp air before driving back down to Pokhara. Spend the afternoon enjoying leisurely activities around Lakeside. You can hire a wooden boat on Phewa Lake, visit local artisan shops, or simply relax at a cozy cafe while reflecting on your Himalayan adventures.

itinerary.title: Early Morning Sunrise from Sarangkot and Fly Back to Kathmandu
itinerary.description: Rise early to drive up to Sarangkot for a breathtaking sunrise over the Annapurna and Dhaulagiri mountain ranges. Watch the snowy peaks turn golden before heading to the airport for your short domestic flight back to Kathmandu. Transfer to your hotel for rest and evening exploration.

itinerary.title: Visit Bhaktapur and Pashupatinath Temple
itinerary.description: Explore Bhaktapur Durbar Square in the morning, marveling at the 55-Window Palace and Nyatapola Temple while observing traditional pottery making. Later, visit the holy Pashupatinath Temple complex on the banks of the Bagmati River to observe sacred Hindu traditions, open-air ghats, and spiritual evening aarti rituals.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Enjoy your final morning in Kathmandu with a relaxed breakfast and some last-minute souvenir shopping for local crafts or tea. Depending on your flight schedule, transfer to Tribhuvan International Airport for your departure home, taking with you unforgettable memories of Nepal’s rich cultural heritage and landscapes.

mustang.title: Mustang Tiji Festival Photography Tour
mustang.subtitle: Ancient Tibetan Rituals Trans Himalayan Deserts
mustang.overview: This 15 day photography expedition offers an extraordinary journey through Nepal's most visually dramatic landscapes and cultural spectacles. Anchored by the world famous Tiji Festival in Lo Manthang the medieval walled capital of Upper Mustang you will photograph sacred masked dances (Chham) performed by Buddhist monks in vibrant brocade robes to drive away evil spirits. Traverse stark trans Himalayan desert canyons, red sandstone cliffs and ancient sky caves carved into sheer cliff faces.

highlights.title: Tiji Festival Masked Dances
highlights.description: Photograph the 3 day sacred Tiji Festival in Lo Manthang, capturing monks in elaborate brocade attire and deity masks performing ancient exorcism rituals.

highlights.title: Lo Manthang Walled Capital
highlights.description: Explore the 15th century walled kingdom of Lo Manthang, documenting ancient monasteries, narrow cobblestone alleys, and traditional Lopa culture.

highlights.title: Trans Himalayan Red Canyons & Sky Caves
highlights.description: Capture surreal red sandstone cliffs at Ghami and Drakmar, and explore the multi storied mysterious Jhong Sky Caves of Chhoser.

highlights.title: Royal Bardiya Bengal Tiger Tracking
highlights.description: Embark on guided jeep and walking safaris through Bardiya National Park, Nepal's best wild habitat for tracking Bengal tigers and wild elephants.

highlights.title: Karnali River Rafting & River Dolphins
highlights.description: Drift along the pristine Karnali and Babai rivers photographing freshwater gangetic dolphins, mugger crocodiles, and rare endemic bird species.

highlights.title: Aerial Mountain Views & High Himalayan Passes
highlights.description: Enjoy spectacular mountain flights over the Kali Gandaki Gorge, the world's deepest gorge, sandwiched between Dhaulagiri and Annapurna massifs.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kathmandu & transfer to hotel
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at Tribhuvan International Airport in Kathmandu our representative will warmly greet you and transfer you to your hotel. Rest after your long flight and adapt to local time. In the late afternoon enjoy a stroll through the bustling streets before joining the team for a comprehensive photo expedition briefing and welcome dinner.

itinerary.title: UNESCO Heritage Sites: Swayambhunath & Boudhanath Stupa
itinerary.description: Begin early at Swayambhunath Stupa capturing golden morning light on ancient stupas prayer wheels and panoramic views over Kathmandu Valley, then visit Pashupatinath, temple dedicated to lord Shiva. Here you can get the beautiful photos of ancient temples and Sadhus (hermit). In the afternoon visit Boudhanath Stupa the heart of Tibetan Buddhism in Kathmandu photographing monks and pilgrims performing sacred circumambulations (kora) amidst fluttering prayer flags

itinerary.title: Flight to Pokhara & Drive to Lete
itinerary.description: Take a 25 minute scenic mountain flight from Kathmandu to Pokhara offering breathtaking aerial views of the Langtang Manaslu and Annapurna ranges. Upon arrival, board an off road 4WD vehicle for a rugged drive through the Kali Gandaki Valley toward Lete passing traditional apple orchards of and wind swept Himalayan riverbeds.

itinerary.title: Overland Drive Lete to Kagbeni via Lupra Village
itinerary.description: Cross the checkpoint into Upper Mustang at Kagbeni, an ancient medieval fortress village. Drive through stark trans Himalayan desert landscapes passing colorful chortens, terraced barley fields and dramatic red sandstone canyon walls before arriving at Ghami village.

itinerary.title: Drive Kagbeni to Ghami via Tangge village
itinerary.description: Depart Kagbeni for a rugged off-road drive into Upper Mustang’s dramatic high-desert terrain. Traverse windswept mountain passes and barren canyons before making a detour toward Tangge, a secluded village famous for its striking row of chortens and traditional mud-brick architecture. Continue navigating steep dirt tracks, crossing riverbeds and sculpted sandstone cliffs, until reaching Ghami. Surrounded by green fields and red cliffs, Ghami greets you with Mustang's longest mani wall.

itinerary.title: Drive Ghami to Lo Manthang Walled Capital
itinerary.description: Drive over the Tsarang Pass (3870m) and past the magnificent red cliffs of Drakmar. Continue toward the historical walled capital of Lo Manthang. Upon arrival check into your teahouse lodge and spend the afternoon photographing the 15th century city walls, royal palace courtyard and town square as preparations for Tiji Festival get underway.

itinerary.title: Tiji Festival Day 1: Harassment of Demons (Tsa Chham)
itinerary.description: The opening day of the sacred Tiji Festival! Position yourself around the main palace square of Lo Manthang to photograph the ceremonial arrival of the King of Mustang and high lamas. Witness monks dressed in elaborate brocade robes and deity masks perform the 'Tsa Chham' dance depicting the story of Dorje Jono overcoming demon forces to restore water to Mustang.

itinerary.title: Tiji Festival Day 2: Dispersion of Evil Spirit (Nga Chham)
itinerary.description: Day two of Tiji focuses on the enactment of celestial weapons and spiritual transformation. Monks perform the 'Nga Chham' dance in intricate animal and deity masks. Capture dramatic motion, vibrant silk costumes, traditional Tibetan horns (dungchen) and intense facial expressions of local Lopa villagers doused in spiritual devotion.

itinerary.title: Tiji Festival Day 3: Destruction of Evil & Triumphant Procession
itinerary.description: The grand finale of Tiji Festival! Monks and villagers join a dramatic procession outside the city walls. The high monk shoots a sacred arrow at an effigy representing evil spirits symbolizing peace, prosperity and renewal for Mustang. Photograph the wild firing of muskets, horse processions and joyful village celebrations.

itinerary.title: Chhoser Sky Caves & Garphu Monastery Exploration
itinerary.description: Take a short drive to the Chhoser valley near the Tibetan border. Explore and photograph the multi storied Jhong Sky Cave carved into vertical cliff walls thousands of years ago. Visit Garphu and Nyphu monasteries built into cliff faces capturing ancient Tibetan murals and monk apprentices at study.

itinerary.title: Overland Drive Lo Manthang back to Jomsom
itinerary.description: Bid farewell to Lo Manthang and begin your return journey south through Upper Mustang. Stop to photograph the iconic Mani wall of Ghami, the longest in Nepal and dramatic afternoon shadows stretching across the yellow and pink desert mountains before reaching Jomsom.

itinerary.title: Flight Jomsom to Pokhara and Explore the city of Pokhara
itinerary.description: Start your day with an early morning, 20-minute scenic flight from Jomsom to Pokhara. As you glide over the deep Kali Gandaki Gorge, enjoy spectacular aerial views of the majestic Annapurna and Dhaulagiri mountain ranges. Upon arrival in the vibrant lakeside city of Pokhara, check into your hotel to unwind. Spend the afternoon exploring this beautiful city, enjoy a peaceful boat ride on Phewa Lake, visit the famous Tal Barahi Temple, or simply stroll around the lively Lakeside area.

itinerary.title: Fly back to Kathmandu and ancient palaces
itinerary.description: Fly back to Kathmandu and immerse yourself in the rich heritage of the Valley’s ancient royal cities. First, explore Patan Durbar Square, famous for its refined Newari craftsmanship, Krishna Mandir, and bronze art. Next, head to Bhaktapur Durbar Square to admire the 55-Window Palace, Golden Gate, and Nyatapola Temple. Walk through vibrant courtyards, witness traditional pottery making, and soak in centuries of architectural splendor before calling it a day.

itinerary.title: Final Departure from Kathmandu
itinerary.description: Enjoy a relaxed final breakfast at your hotel. Depending on your flight schedule our team will coordinate a private transfer to Tribhuvan International Airport approximately three hours prior to departure bidding you farewell after an extraordinary Himalayan photography expedition.

holi.title: Holi Festival Photography Tour
holi.subtitle: Vibrant Colors Historic Durbar Squares & Ancient Newar Traditions
holi.overview: A Holi festival photography trip in Nepal is a sensory explosion offering a front row seat to the world’s most cinematic celebration of spring. In the historic UNESCO World Heritage squares of Kathmandu and Patan photographers capture the raw energy of Fagu Purnima as ancient brick temples become backdrops for vibrant clouds of vermillion indigo and yellow powder. What sets Nepal apart is the architectural framing of the juxtaposition of joyful color chaos against medieval Newari woodcarvings, ancient stupas and sacred shrines. From the ceremonial raising of the Chir pole to street music and Holi in Kathmandu and Terai, south of Kathmandu offers high contrast cultural storytelling found nowhere else on earth.

highlights.title: Cinematic Spring in Kathmandu
highlights.description: Experience a sensory explosion and a front row seat to the world’s most cinematic celebration of spring across UNESCO Durbar Squares.

highlights.title: Historic Durbar Square Backdrops
highlights.description: Capture the raw energy of Fagu Purnima in Kathmandu, Patan, and Bhaktapur as ancient brick temples frame clouds of vibrant powder.

highlights.title: The Sacred Chir Ceremony
highlights.description: Witness and photograph the ceremonial raising of the Chir, a tall wooden pole decorated with colorful banners marking the start of Holi.

highlights.title: Bhaktapur & Newar Heritage
highlights.description: Explore the medieval alleys, pottery squares, and traditional Newar musical processions of Bhaktapur during festival days.

highlights.title: Pokhara Lakeside Festivities
highlights.description: Photograph relaxed lakeside celebrations along Phewa Lake with the snow capped Annapurna peaks reflecting on calm waters.

highlights.title: Cultural Portraiture & Golden Light
highlights.description: Capture authentic street portraiture of holy sadhus, local artisans, and smiling revelers doused in bright pigments of joy.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kathmandu & Swayambhunath Sunset
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at Tribhuvan International Airport in Kathmandu our representative will greet you and transfer you to your hotel. In the late afternoon embark on your first photography session at Swayambhunath Stupa. Capture golden hour light illuminating the ancient eyes of Buddha fluttering prayer flags and panoramic views over Kathmandu Valley. In the evening gather for a trip briefing and welcome dinner.

itinerary.title: Raising of the Chir & Asan Bazaar Photo Walk
itinerary.description: Begin with an early morning street photography walk through the narrow sensory rich alleys of Asan and Indra Chowk capturing merchants spice markets and morning worship. Afterwards head to Kathmandu Durbar Square to photograph the ceremonial erection of the Chir a tall wooden pole decorated with colorful cloth swatches that officially signals the arrival of Fagu Purnima (Holi).

itinerary.title: Sacred Shrines & Sadhus: Pashupatinath & Boudhanath
itinerary.description: Spend the morning at Pashupatinath Temple Nepal's most revered Hindu sanctuary along the Bagmati River. Photograph ascetics and holy sadhus with painted faces, ceremonial tridents and traditional attire. In the afternoon visit Boudhanath Stupa one of the world's largest spherical stupas photographing Tibetan monks and devotees performing circumambulations (kora) in warm afternoon light.

itinerary.title: Fagu Purnima (Holi Main Day: Kathmandu & Patan Durbar Squares)
itinerary.description: Today is the peak celebration of Holi in the Kathmandu Valley! Armed with camera protective covers, we head into Kathmandu Durbar Square and Patan Durbar Square. Immerse yourself in the joyful chaos as clouds of red vermillion turquoise and yellow powders fill the air against 15th century woodcarvings and stone temples. Capture drummers energetic dance crowds and spontaneous street celebrations throughout the day.

itinerary.title: Fly to Janakpur for Terai Holi Celebration
itinerary.description: Take a short, scenic flight from Kathmandu to Janakpur, the cultural heart of the Terai region. Upon arrival, dive straight into the vibrant energy of the Terai Holi celebration. Unlike the hilly regions, Holi here is a grand festival filled with traditional music, folk dances, and colorful street processions. Smear vibrant colored powders with welcoming locals and experience the rich Maithil culture. Later, visit the stunning Ram Janaki Temple, beautifully illuminated for the festive evening.

itinerary.title: Drive to Chitwan National Park
itinerary.description: After breakfast, embark on a scenic drive to Chitwan National Park, transitioning from the cultural plains of Janakpur to lush, subtropical jungles. The journey offers beautiful glimpses of rural Nepalese life, winding rivers, and terraced landscapes. Upon arriving at your jungle lodge, enjoy a warm welcome and a brief orientation. Spend the late afternoon relaxing by the Rapti River, watching a mesmerizing sunset before enjoying a traditional Tharu cultural dance performance in the warm evening.

itinerary.title: Jungle Safari inside National Park
itinerary.description: Dive into the heart of Chitwan National Park for an exhilarating day of wildlife encounters. Start with an early morning jeep safari or elephant grass walk to spot the rare one-horned rhinoceros, various deer species, and perhaps the elusive Royal Bengal tiger. Glide down the Rapti River in a traditional dugout canoe, keeping an eye out for mugger crocodiles and vibrant birdlife. Return to your lodge for a peaceful evening immersed in nature's relaxing sounds.

itinerary.title: Drive to Pokhara and Visit the Shanti Stupa and Shiva statue
itinerary.description: Bid farewell to the jungle and enjoy a scenic drive to Pokhara, nestled beside Phewa Lake beneath the Annapurna range. After checking into your lakeside hotel, head up to the magnificent World Peace Pagoda for panoramic views of the mountains and city. Next, visit the towering Pumdikot Shiva Statue, a spectacular new landmark offering breathtaking viewpoints. Conclude your day with a relaxing stroll along the vibrant lakeside, enjoying the cool, refreshing evening mountain lake breeze.

itinerary.title: Sarangkot Himalayan Sunrise & Flight to Kathmandu
itinerary.description: Wake up early for a drive to Sarangkot viewpoint to photograph sunrise over the Annapurna Massif and the iconic summit of Machhapuchhare (Fishtail). After breakfast enjoy a peaceful boat ride across Phewa Lake to Tal Barahi Temple. In the afternoon take a return flight to Kathmandu and enjoy a farewell celebration dinner with the group.

itinerary.title: Visit Bhaktapur Durbar and Changunarayan
itinerary.description: Spend the day exploring two UNESCO World Heritage Sites. Start at Bhaktapur Durbar Square to admire magnificent medieval Newari architecture, including the 55-Window Palace, Vatsala Temple, and the soaring Nyatapola Temple. Afterwards, drive to Changu Narayan, Nepal’s oldest ancient Hindu temple, perched atop a ridge. Here, you'll marvel at 5th-century stone carvings, intricate wood sculptures, and rich historic inscriptions before returning with a deeper appreciation of the Valley's cultural heritage.

itinerary.title: Final Departure from Kathmandu
itinerary.description: Enjoy a relaxed final breakfast at your hotel. Take advantage of free morning hours to pick up last minute Nepalese handicrafts tea or souvenirs. Our representative will arrange a private airport transfer three hours prior to your scheduled flight bidding you farewell after an unforgettable Holi photography journey.

shaman.title: Shaman Festival Tour
shaman.subtitle: Sacred Rituals Kham Magar Culture & Dhorpatan Wilderness
shaman.overview: Embark on an extraordinary 12 day cultural and photographic odyssey into Rukum East one of Nepal's most remote and authentic mountain regions. Centerpiece to this journey is the celebrated Jhakri Mela (Shaman Festival) in Lukum Village where dozens of shamans assemble in feathered crowns bronze bells and sacred attire to perform rhythmic drumming spiritual invocations and ancient healing rituals preserved across generations by the Kham Magar community. Beyond the shamanic celebrations, travel through traditional stone roofed settlements like Taksera, walk across Nepal's famous Kusma Suspension Bridge and explore the high altitude plateau of Dhorpatan Hunting Reserve Nepal's only wildlife sanctuary for rare alpine species like blue sheep.

highlights.title: Jhakri Mela (Shaman Festival)
highlights.description: Witness authentic Kham Magar shamanic rituals, rhythmic drumbeats, feathered headdresses, and hypnotic ancestral dances in Lukum Village.

highlights.title: Sisno (Stinging Nettle) Ritual
highlights.description: Experience the unique symbolic stinging nettle ritual performed by villagers to cleanse negative energy, protect against illness, and renew body and spirit.

highlights.title: Playful Soil & Earth Celebration
highlights.description: Participate in the joyful Day 2 celebration where mountain earth flies through the air, honoring the fertile soil that sustains every family.

highlights.title: Untouched Kham Magar Heritage
highlights.description: Explore traditional stone roofed villages in Lukum and Taksera untouched by commercial tourism, learning hemp weaving and traditional shamanic traditions.

highlights.title: Dhorpatan Hunting Reserve
highlights.description: Journey into Nepal's only protected hunting reserve, a stunning high altitude alpine plateau home to blue sheep, Himalayan thar, and Tibetan monasteries.

highlights.title: Kusma Suspension Bridge & Scenic Drives
highlights.description: Cross one of Nepal's highest pedestrian footbridges over the Kali Gandaki River gorge and take scenic flights between Kathmandu and Pokhara.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kathmandu and Transfer to Hotel
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at Tribhuvan International Airport in Kathmandu our representative will warmly greet you and arrange a private transfer to your centrally located hotel. This introductory day is dedicated to resting after your long journey adapting to the new time zone and absorbing the lively atmosphere of Nepal's historic capital. During the afternoon enjoy a leisurely stroll through the colorful streets of Thamel to explore shops and cafes. In the evening join for a comprehensive briefing for the trip.

itinerary.title: Fly to Pokhara and Drive to Kusma
itinerary.description: After breakfast take a scenic twenty five minute flight from Kathmandu to Pokhara enjoying breathtaking aerial views of the Langtang Manaslu and Annapurna mountain ranges. Upon landing, board a private off road vehicle for a picturesque highway drive west toward Kusma the district headquarters of Parbat. Stop along the way to walk across the famous Kusma Suspension Bridge, one of Nepal's highest pedestrian footbridges spanning the Kali Gandaki River gorge. Afterward visit the revered Kalika Temple, a significant Hindu shrine offering serene spiritual ambiance and panoramic valley views before settling into your comfortable hotel in Kusma for the night.

itinerary.title: Drive to Lugum Village
itinerary.description: Depart Kusma after breakfast for an exciting mountain drive into Rukum East traveling along winding roads through terraced hillsides, pine forests and dramatic river canyons. Your destination is Lukum (Lugum Village) a traditional Magar settlement famous for its stone roofed architecture and indigenous heritage. Upon afternoon arrival check into a community lodge or homestay and spend the remaining daylight hours exploring the narrow stone pathways. Observe daily agricultural routines and weaving practices untouched by commercial tourism. Engage with village elders to understand the spiritual significance of local shamanism before savoring an organic locally sourced dinner prepared by your hosts.

itinerary.title: Jhakri Mela (Shaman Festival Day 1)
itinerary.description:
Today marks the opening of the celebrated Jhakri Mela, an extraordinary shamanic gathering bringing spiritual practitioners together from the remote village of Lukum. Immerse yourself in the festival atmosphere as shamans assemble in elaborate attire featuring feathered headdresses, bells, cowrie shells and sacred wooden drums. Spend the day observing rhythmic drumbeats, hypnotic chanting and ritualistic dances performed to honor ancestral deities and ensure prosperous harvests. Witness authentic healing ceremonies and spiritual invocations preserved for centuries among the Kham Magar community. In the evening join local villagers around communal campfires to share folk stories, traditional songs and festive delicacies.

One of the festival's most distinctive customs is the Sisno (stinging nettle) ritual. Fresh nettles are gently used by the villagers as they playfully strike one another. To an outsider the practice may seem unusual but for the people of Lukum it carries deep symbolic meaning. The community believes the ritual helps cleanse the body, remove negative influences and offer protection from illness and misfortune in the coming year. What appears playful on the surface is for the villagers another way of renewing both body and spirit.

itinerary.title: Jhakri Mela (Shaman Festival Day 2)
itinerary.description: If yesterday belonged to the spirits, today belongs to the people. Solemn chants give way to laughter and lively folk beats as the village celebrates completing the sacred rituals. Younger shaman apprentices take center stage, their energetic drumming echoing across the square as they playfully tease young women through song and dance. Soon a Holi like celebration unfolds: handfuls of mountain earth fly through the air covering villagers and willing visitors in mud. This playful ritual honors the fertile soil that sustains every family reminding everyone that all distinctions of age, wealth and status disappear when covered in earth. Conclude this unforgettable cultural experience with an authentic evening dinner.

itinerary.title: Drive to Taksera Village
itinerary.description: Following breakfast and a warm send off in Lugum board your four wheel drive vehicle for a rugged mountain journey to Taksera another prominent Kham Magar settlement in Rukum East. Nestled amidst dramatic mountain ridges and alpine meadows Taksera offers an enchanting window into authentic Himalayan village architecture. After checking into a charming homestay enjoy a traditional lunch of buckwheat millet and mountain vegetables. In the afternoon take a guided walking tour through tightly clustered stone dwellings visiting historic shrines and scenic viewpoints. Watch artisans craft hemp garments and wooden utensils before enjoying an authentic dinner around a cozy hearth.

itinerary.title: Drive to Burtibang
itinerary.description: After a leisurely breakfast in Taksera bid farewell to the highlands of Rukum East and begin your return drive southeast toward Burtibang in Baglung District. Today’s overland route crosses dramatic mountain passes descending through dense rhododendron and oak forests, secluded river valleys and cascading waterfalls. Along the way make strategic stops at scenic viewpoints and traditional teahouses to stretch your legs, sip fresh Nepali tea and photograph the changing landscapes. Observe the gradual transition from rugged alpine architecture to terraced subtropical farmlands. Arrive in Burtibang by late afternoon to check into your hotel and explore the bustling bazaar.

itinerary.title: Burtibang to Dhorpatan
itinerary.description: Today your journey into one of Nepal's remote wilderness areas drives from Burtibang up to the expansive valley of Dhorpatan Hunting Reserve. The off-road ascent climbs through lush pine forests, open grazing pastures and crystalline streams before reaching a magnificent high altitude plateau surrounded by snow capped Himalayan peaks. Renowned as Nepal's only protected hunting reserve, Dhorpatan provides a vital sanctuary for rare alpine wildlife like blue sheep and Himalayan thar. Upon arrival check into a simple community lodge. Spend the afternoon taking a refreshing nature walk across the valley floor visiting the seasonal Tibetan settlement and monastery.

itinerary.title: Drive Back to Baglung
itinerary.description: After waking to crisp alpine air and enjoying breakfast overlooking the peaceful Dhorpatan valley begin your eastward overland journey back to the regional hub of Baglung. Descend from the high plateau along scenic dirt roads tracing rushing mountain rivers and passing through rural farming hamlets and terraced fields. Stop for a midday lunch at a roadside settlement before continuing along the improved highway toward Baglung Bazaar. Upon afternoon arrival check into your well appointed hotel to unwind from the drive. Later explore the town center before evening dinner.

itinerary.title: Drive to Pokhara
itinerary.description: Following breakfast in Baglung enjoy a smooth 2 hours drive along the paved Mid-Hill Highway back to Pokhara. Upon arrival check into your lakeside hotel and spend the afternoon discovering the city's celebrated natural and cultural attractions. Begin with a tranquil boat ride across Phewa Lake to visit the island temple of Tal Barahi. If weather permits, Boating in the Fewa lake and visiting the iconic World Peace Pagoda to have a beautiful view of Pokhara city and Annapurna range. Spend your evening exploring the lively Lakeside promenade.

itinerary.title: Fly Back to Kathmandu and Sightseeing
itinerary.description: After a breakfast in Pokhara transfer to the domestic airport for your short scenic return flight to Kathmandu. Upon touching down in the capital check into your hotel before embarking on a guided afternoon cultural tour of the valley's UNESCO World Heritage Sites. Visit the monumental Boudhanath Stupa joining pilgrims circumambulating the sacred dome amidst fluttering prayer flags. Next proceed to the sacred Hindu temple complex of Pashupatinath along the Bagmati River to observe intricate pagoda architecture. Conclude your day with a special celebration dinner at a fine traditional Nepali restaurant.

itinerary.title: Final Departure
itinerary.description: Your memorable cultural and wilderness journey across Nepal concludes today. Enjoy a relaxed final breakfast at your hotel taking advantage of any remaining free time for last minute souvenir shopping packing. Depending on your flight schedule our team will coordinate a smooth private transfer to Tribhuvan International Airport approximately three hours prior to your departure. As you drive to the airport take a final look at the bustling streets of Kathmandu. Our representative will assist with your luggage and bid you a warm farewell for your journey home.

photography.bisketJatra: Bisket Jatra Festival, Nepalese New Year and Bardia National Park

bisketJatraTrip.title: Bisket Jatra Festival & Nepalese New Year
bisketJatraTrip.subtitle: A Festive & Cultural Pilgrimage
bisketJatraTrip.overview: The Bisket Jatra is a spectacular celebration marking the Nepalese New Year in Bhaktapur. This ancient festival opens with a fierce tug of war between the city's quarters to pull the colossal chariot of the god Bhairav. The excitement reaches its climax with the erection of the Linga, a sacred pole whose fall symbolises victory over demonic forces. Thimi the festival turns a vibrant orange during Sindur Jatra where an ecstatic crowd showers each other with vermilion powder. The ritual ends with the impressive tongue piercing in Bode, an act of extreme devotion to ensure community prosperity. Between mystical fervor and explosions of colors this festival is a visceral immersion into the soul and ancient traditions of the Newar people.

highlights.title: Bhairav Chariot Tug of War
highlights.description: Participate in the collective fervor as you witness the friendly rivalry to pull the colossal wooden chariot in Bhaktapur.

highlights.title: Erection of the Sacred Linga
highlights.description: Witness the perilous raising of a 25 meter wooden pole symbolizing the victory over demonic forces.

highlights.title: Sindur Jatra in Thimi
highlights.description: Experience an explosion of colors as the ecstatic crowd showers itself in vibrant orange vermilion powder.

highlights.title: Tongue Piercing in Bode
highlights.description: Observe this extreme and spectacular ritual of devotion performed to guarantee prosperity for the village.

highlights.title: Bardia Wildlife Safari
highlights.description: Track the royal Bengal tiger and the one horned rhinoceros in the pristine wilderness of Bardia National Park.

highlights.title: Serenity of Lumbini
highlights.description: Visit the sacred Maya Devi Temple in Lumbini, the historical birthplace of Lord Buddha.

itinerary.title: Arrival and transfer to hotel
itinerary.description: Welcome to Kathmandu. Once you settle in hotel, dive into the buzz of this legendary district. It is a sensory labyrinth where prayer flags float above craft shops and lively cafes. Explore the narrow streets, breathe in the scent of incense and masala tea and observe the small shrines hidden in the inner courtyards.

itinerary.title: Flight to Nepalgunj and drive to Bardia National Park
itinerary.description: Leave the valley for the wild west of Nepal. After a scenic flight to Nepalgunj, drive through authentic rural landscapes to reach Bardia National Park. More isolated and preserved than Chitwan, Bardia offers a raw immersion into nature. Upon arrival check into your lodge on the edge of the forest. Spend the end of the day walking through the surrounding Tharu villages. The absolute calm and warm air of the jungle mark a striking contrast with Kathmandu preparing you for an exploration in the heart of one of the last refuges of the Royal Bengal Tiger.

itinerary.title: Wild Safari in Bardia National Park
itinerary.description: Dedicate your entire day to exploring the pristine wilderness of Bardia National Park, a premier sanctuary of biodiversity. Whether you choose an exhilarating jeep safari or a thrilling guided jungle walk, immerse yourself in the dense forest environment. Keep your eyes peeled and your camera ready as you actively search for the majestic Bengal tiger, the elusive grand one horned rhinoceros, and towering wild elephants roaming freely around.

itinerary.title: Walk along the Karnali River
itinerary.description: Embark on a highly peaceful and deeply immersive river walk along the stunning banks of the mighty Karnali River. This tranquil excursion offers exceptional opportunities for nature photography and quiet reflection. Watch closely for fascinating marsh mugger crocodiles basking in the sun, beautifully vibrant migratory birds flying above, and large herds of wild animals carefully approaching the sandy riverbanks to drink and cool off this warm, sunny afternoon.

itinerary.title: Drive Bardia to Lumbini
itinerary.description: Bid farewell to the untamed wilderness and travel south from the dense jungle toward the historically sacred plains of Lumbini. This scenic overland drive transitions you from thrilling wildlife encounters to deep spiritual reflection. Upon arrival, you will explore the extraordinarily peaceful birthplace of Siddhartha Gautama, the Buddha. Experience profound tranquility as you wander past ancient monastic ruins, beautiful temples, and the sacred garden honoring our most revered spiritual master.

itinerary.title: Return to the serenity of Pokhara and Durlung village
itinerary.description: Take a scenic flight to Pokhara, enjoying breathtaking views of the Annapurna range. Upon arrival, embark on a short drive toward Durlung, a tranquil community village nestled in the hills. Experience authentic local hospitality, traditional homestay living, and panoramic mountain vistas. Stroll through terraced fields, interact with warm villagers, and immerse yourself in the rich culture and daily rural life of Nepal away from the busy tourist trails.

itinerary.title: Drive back to Pokhara and leisure time
itinerary.description: After breakfast in Durlung, drive back to the vibrant lakeside city of Pokhara. Spend the rest of the day at your own pace. Relax by Phewa Lake, enjoy a peaceful boat ride to Tal Barahi Temple, or stroll through the colorful streets lined with lively cafes and shops. For the adventurous, optional activities like paragliding or visiting the World Peace Pagoda offer stunning views before a relaxing lakeside evening.

itinerary.title: Return to Kathmandu
itinerary.description: Rise early for a drive to Sarangkot to witness a spectacular sunrise illuminating the Annapurna and Dhaulagiri mountain ranges. Watch the peaks glow golden before returning for breakfast. Afterward, head to Pokhara Airport for your short flight back to Kathmandu. Upon landing, transfer to your hotel or spend the remainder of the day sightseeing, shopping for souvenirs, or reflecting on your memorable journey through the Himalayas.

itinerary.title: The Chariot of Bisket Jatra in Bhaktapur
itinerary.description: Plunge into the effervescence of Bhaktapur for the start of the Bisket Jatra festival. The highlight is the pulling of the massive chariot of the god Bhairav. Hundreds of locals pull on huge ropes in a friendly competition between the upper and lower quarters of the city. The energy is electric, the crowd is huge and dust flies to the rhythm of devotional chants. It is a raw and beautiful immersion into one of Nepal's oldest living traditions.

itinerary.title: Patan Pashupatinath and Boudhanath
itinerary.description: A day dedicated to the spiritual gems of the valley. Start with Patan, the city of arts famous for its metal sculptures and refined architecture. Then head to Pashupatinath the country's most sacred Hindu temple on the banks of the Bagmati River to observe cremation rituals and the devotion of sadhus. End with the giant stupa of Boudhanath, the center of Tibetan Buddhism. Join the pilgrims for the 'Kora' (circumambulation) around the white dome under the benevolent eyes of the Buddha.

itinerary.title: Serenity in Bhaktapur
itinerary.description: After the festive chaos rediscover Bhaktapur in a calmer atmosphere. Explore the potters' square where hundreds of clay pots dry in the sun creating geometric patterns on the ground. Admire the Palace of 55 Windows and the Nyatapola Temple, the tallest in Nepal. Every street corner reveals intricate wood carvings and centuries old bricks. This museum city is perfect for understanding the ingenuity of Newar artisans and the harmony that reigns in this preserved medieval city.

itinerary.title: Raising the Linga in Bhaktapur
itinerary.description: Return to the intensity of the festival for the erection of the 'Linga' a giant wooden pole symbolizing victory over negative forces. The crowd gathers at Lyasinkhel to witness this perilous and symbolic act. The fall of the pole the next day will mark the official start of the Nepalese New Year. Chants cymbals and the enthusiasm of devotees create a mystical and vibrant atmosphere.

itinerary.title: Brick Factories of Bhaktapur
itinerary.description: Today head out of the historical center to explore the outskirts where the impressive hand crafted brick factories are located. This unique industrial landscape offers a striking contrast to the carved temples. Observe the colossal work of the laborers shaping and stacking thousands of clay bricks under the sun. High chimneys belching smoke and the geometric structures of red bricks create an almost cinematic atmosphere. It is a poignant immersion into the local economy and manual labor that has built the Kathmandu Valley for centuries.

itinerary.title: Sindur Jatra and Tongue Piercing in Thimi
itinerary.description: Live the climax of the festivities in Thimi and Bode. Witness the Sindur Jatra where participants drench each other in bright orange vermilion powder in an ecstatic atmosphere. The palanquins of the gods dance in a cloud of color symbolizing the victory of spring. In Bode witness the impressive tongue piercing ritual where a devotee has their tongue pierced by a metal rod to ensure village prosperity. It is a visceral, intense and exceptionally powerful cultural experience marking the end of the festival.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Your journey comes to an end. Depending on your flight time enjoy your last moments buying hand crafted souvenirs or tasting local flavors once more. Imbued with the colors of the festival, the peace of the mountains and the fervor of the temples you leave Nepal with everlasting memories.

photography.nepalColorsContrasts: Shivaratri Festival: Color and Contrast to Nepal

nepalColorsContrastsTrip.title: Shivaratri Festival: Color and Contrast to Nepal
nepalColorsContrastsTrip.subtitle: A Photographer's Paradise & Sacred Festivals
nepalColorsContrastsTrip.overview:
Nepal is a magnificent Himalayan country, rich in history, fascinating art, and unique architecture. Despite its small size, it is globally renowned as a nation of colors and contrasts, a hidden Shangri La where nature, culture, and adventure blend seamlessly. For any visitor, Nepal is a myth, the kingdom of the Himalayas. An intensely spiritual Hindu and Buddhist land, and particularly famous for its mountains, this kingdom lies at the heart of the Himalayas.

Nepal is a photographer's paradise. Capture the ethereal glow of the Himalayas at dawn, then plunge into the lush jungle of Chitwan in search of one horned rhinos and elusive wildlife. On ancient squares, marvel at the explosion of colors during sacred festivals and soak up the timeless soul of Newar culture. From the weather beaten, smiling faces of Nepalese people to the serene eyes of monks, every shot tells the story of a land where spirituality and nature meet in spectacular light.

highlights.title: Shivaratri, the Greatest Festival of Shiva
highlights.description: Celebrate the greatest festival of Shiva at the sacred Pashupatinath temple amidst thousands of sadhus and devotees.

highlights.title: Loshar, the Tibetan New Year
highlights.description: Experience the Tibetan and Sherpa New Year festival at Boudhanath Stupa with a large local community.

highlights.title: Annapurna Region
highlights.description: Admire the exceptional panorama of the Annapurna, Machhapuchhare, and Dhaulagiri mountain ranges.

highlights.title: Navadurga Festivals & Sacred Dances
highlights.description: Witness the Navadurga festivals and the sacred masked Cham dances performed by the monks.

highlights.title: Durlung and Landruk Villages
highlights.description: Discover the Gurung way of life, taste authentic local cuisine, and stay with a host family.

highlights.title: Chitwan Wildlife Safari
highlights.description: Embark on jeep and elephant back safaris to search for the one-horned rhinoceros and Bengal tiger.

itinerary.title: Arrival and transfer to hotel, walk in Thamel
itinerary.description: Namaste and welcome to Kathmandu, Nepal! Your arrival at Tribhuvan International Airport is a unique experience. Waiting times for immigration depend on whether you obtain a visa on arrival or in advance. As you exit the baggage claim/customs area at Kathmandu Airport, a security officer will collect your baggage tags. Please note that luggage trolleys are available free of charge at the airport. Enjoy a discovery walk in Thamel.

itinerary.title: Drive to Chitwan
itinerary.description: From Kathmandu, the drive to Chitwan, of about 160 km, takes approximately 6 hours. Enjoy stunning views of the Trishuli River, villages, terraced rice fields, suspension bridges, and surrounding mountains. At Mugling, turn south and descend gradually from the central hills into the fertile plains of the Western Terai and Chitwan National Park. This park is famous for its one-horned rhinos, Bengal tigers, and other wildlife. Visit an ethnic Tharu village in the afternoon.

itinerary.title: Elephant back and jeep safari
itinerary.description: This day is dedicated to a wildlife safari in the heart of the jungle. The jungle safari will take you through Chitwan National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage site. Established in 1973, Chitwan National Park covers 932 km² of subtropical valleys and dense forests. It is home to 694 one-horned rhinos, 128 Bengal tigers, leopards, wild elephants, gharials, nilgai, and many other wild animals, as well as more than 650 bird species. Amidst these natural wonders, Chitwan National Park invites you to a complete immersion in the wild jungle atmosphere.

itinerary.title: Drive to Bandipur
itinerary.description: We leave Chitwan and cross the deep gorges of the Narayani River to join the countryside, its small villages, and farms along winding roads to Bandipur, a beautifully preserved hilltop town adorned with traditional Newar houses. We follow the historic trail from Dumre Bazaar through pristine forests to reach a town that has changed very little. Bandipur invites travelers to discover its unique highlights: a rich mountain culture, exceptional mountain panoramas, and hiking. Unlike most mountain trading posts, Bandipur has preserved its ancient cultural heritage: temples, shrines, sacred caves, countless festivals, and Newar architecture.

itinerary.title: Drive to Pokhara
itinerary.description: We leave Bandipur early in the morning for Pokhara, 80 km away (about 2 hours drive). After lunch, visit Pokhara and its lakesides. Pokhara is one of the most popular tourist destinations in Nepal, also known as the 'city of lakes.' It is famous as the gateway to the Annapurna Circuit, a renowned Himalayan trekking trail.

itinerary.title: Sightseeing in Pokhara
itinerary.description: Start early in the morning to witness the sunrise over the Annapurna range and Machapuchare (Fishtail). Most visitors head there at dawn or dusk when the sun sets the peaks ablaze in flaming colors. You will admire the breathtaking sunrise over the Annapurna range and enjoy a tour of the summit. Visit the World Peace Stupa, also known as Shanti Stupa, a Buddhist pagoda-style monument located on a hilltop overlooking Phewa Lake. This pagoda is dedicated to world peace. Afterwards, visit the Shiva statue, one of the tallest Shiva statues recently erected in Pumdikot, which is a must-see in Pokhara, offering stunning views of the city and the magnificent Annapurna range.

itinerary.title: Drive to Durlung village
itinerary.description: After breakfast, drive to Durlung village. The drive takes about 2 hours for a distance of 60 km. Durlung is a village development committee in Parbat District. It is a Gurung village where you can experience the Gurung culture and lifestyle up close by staying with a local family.

itinerary.title: Drive to Landruk village
itinerary.description: In the morning, visit Durlung school, and after breakfast, set off for Landruk village. The drive takes about 3 hours from Durlung to the charming village of Landruk. Located in the Kaski district of Nepal, Landruk lies in the Annapurna Conservation Area. Perched at approximately 1,600 meters above sea level, it is primarily inhabited by the Gurung community, one of Nepal's indigenous ethnic groups known for their rich culture, traditions, and brave Gurkha soldiers. The village has preserved its traditional charm and is famous for its remarkably well-preserved Gurung architecture, stone houses, paved lanes, and terraced rice fields. One of the main attractions of Landruk is its exceptional panoramic views of the surrounding mountains, providing an ideal vantage point to admire the majestic peaks of Annapurna South, Hiunchuli, and Annapurna South.

itinerary.title: Return to Pokhara
itinerary.description: After breakfast, descend into the valley enjoying breathtaking views of the Annapurna range. On the way back to Pokhara, you will also visit typical Gurung villages and observe terraced fields.

itinerary.title: Return to Kathmandu and visit Kathmandu Royal Palace
itinerary.description: Fly back to Kathmandu (about 30 minutes) offering breathtaking views of the Himalayas. In the late afternoon, visit local markets and Kathmandu Durbar Square. Kathmandu Durbar Square, also known as Hanuman Dhoka Durbar Square, is a historical site in the heart of Kathmandu, the capital of Nepal. A UNESCO World Heritage site, it holds immense cultural, religious, and historical importance. The square is a complex of palaces, temples, courtyards, and buildings that once served as the royal palace for the Malla and Shah dynasties. Ason market, the oldest in Kathmandu, offers an immersive experience in one of the city's busiest and most vibrant markets. It is famous for buying essentials, especially the various spices used in Nepalese cuisine.

itinerary.title: Shivaratri, celebrate the greatest festival of Shiva
itinerary.description: Pashupatinath Temple is dedicated to Shiva, the Hindu god of destruction, also known as Pashupatinath (Lord of Animals). This temple is a place of pilgrimage for Hindu devotees from all over the world. It is located on the banks of the sacred Bagmati River and is finely decorated, showing ancestral craftsmanship. Pashupatinath Temple is home to many Hindu sadhus from around the world. The Shivaratri festival is the most important celebrated annually at Pashupatinath Temple. Devotees stay awake, sing prayers, fast, practice yoga, meditate, or recite prayers to Shiva.

itinerary.title: Patan and Shechen Monastery
itinerary.description: Morning visit to Kathmandu's largest fruit and vegetable market, followed by a visit to Patan Durbar Square, a historical site in Lalitpur, south of Kathmandu. A UNESCO World Heritage site, it holds great cultural and historical significance. Patan Durbar Square is famous for its remarkable architecture, finely crafted woodwork, and rich artistic heritage. Later in the afternoon, visit Shechen Monastery where monks perform the sacred Cham dance. Dressed in silk brocades and masks with both compassionate and wrathful expressions, they move to the thunderous rhythm of long trumpets and cymbals. This vibrant 'meditation in motion' clears the obstacles of the past year.

itinerary.title: Bhaktapur Durbar Square
itinerary.description: Famous for its religious, cultural, and historical heritage, Bhaktapur, also known as Bhadgaun, is rich in ancient arts, religious values, and architectural masterpieces. It is considered an open-air museum. A UNESCO World Heritage site, it offers a unique and immersive visit to brick factories, allowing you to discover the ancestral brick-making techniques used for construction. After breakfast, depart for Bhaktapur where you will visit brick factories. This is an ideal place to hone your photography skills. In the late afternoon, you will have the opportunity to witness the Navadurga festival (dance festival with masks of the goddess Durga).

itinerary.title: Losar Festival (Tibetan New Year), visit Boudhanath and Swayambhunath stupas
itinerary.description: Boudhanath Stupa is one of Nepal's most sacred sites. A UNESCO World Heritage site, this stupa, a symbol of peace and love, was once a resting place for Tibetan merchants. Losar, the Tibetan New Year, is the most important festival in Tibet and for the Tibetan diaspora, especially in Nepal. In Kathmandu, a large Tibetan community is concentrated mainly in the Boudha district. Losar also marks the New Year for the Sherpa community of Nepal. Visit both Boudhanath and Swayambhunath stupas.

itinerary.title: Departure/Airport transfer
itinerary.description: In accordance with airline regulations, transfer to the airport approximately 3 hours before your scheduled flight time. Check in for your return flight. End of this beautiful journey of colors and contrasts.

manaslu-circuit.title: Manaslu Circuit Trek
manaslu-circuit.subtitle: Spirit of the Mountains
manaslu-circuit.overview:
The Manaslu Circuit Trek is one of Nepal’s most spectacular and culturally rich trekking routes, taking you around Mount Manaslu (8,163m), the eighth-highest mountain in the world. Often nicknamed the "Spirit Mountain" by locals, this region offers a quieter and less-commercialized alternative to the more crowded Annapurna and Everest treks. The trail showcases a dramatic evolution of landscapes, transitioning from the steamy, subtropical terraced fields of the Budhi Gandaki valley to the stark, windswept alpine terrain near the Tibetan border.

Culturally, the region is incredibly authentic; trekkers pass through villages like Samagaun and Samdo, where ancient Tibetan Buddhist traditions and monasteries remain virtually untouched by modernity. The journey’s crowning challenge is the crossing of the Larkya La Pass (5,106m), a physical feat that rewards you with panoramic views of Himlung Himal, Cheo Himal, and Annapurna II. Designated as a Restricted Area requiring special permits, the Manaslu Circuit retains a sense of exclusivity and raw wilderness perfect for solitude seekers.

highlights.title: Mount Manaslu
highlights.description: Experience the grandeur of Mount Manaslu (8,163m), the eighth-highest mountain in the world.

highlights.title: Larke La Pass
highlights.description: Challenge yourself crossing the dramatic Larke La Pass (5,160m) for unparalleled mountain views.

highlights.title: Off-the-Beaten-Path
highlights.description: Enjoy remote trails with fewer trekkers compared to Everest & Annapurna regions, offering solitude and exclusivity.

highlights.title: Rich Buddhist Culture
highlights.description: Immerse in authentic Tibetan Buddhist culture through ancient monasteries, mani walls, and fluttering prayer flags mainly in Samagaun and Samdo.

highlights.title: Diverse Landscapes
highlights.description: Witness a dramatic transition from subtropical forests to alpine meadows, glaciers, and high passes.

highlights.title: Mountain Panoramas
highlights.description: Stunning panoramic views including Manaslu, Ganesh Himal, Himlung Himal, Cheo Himal, and Annapurna ranges.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kathmandu and transfer to hotel
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Tribhuvan International Airport in Kathmandu, you will be greeted and transferred to your hotel in the city. In the evening, there will be a trek briefing where you will meet your guide.

itinerary.title: Drive from Kathmandu to Machha Khola
itinerary.description: The journey begins with a long but scenic drive heading west along the Prithvi Highway, following the Budhi Gandaki Valley to Machha Khola.

itinerary.title: Trek from Machha Khola to Jagat
itinerary.description: The trail follows the Budhi Gandaki River, crossing suspension bridges and passing through Khorlabesi and Tatopani hot springs to reach Jagat.

itinerary.title: Trek from Jagat to Deng
itinerary.description: Walk through villages like Salleri and Philim. The valley narrows as you follow the river through gorges to Deng.

itinerary.title: Trek from Deng to Namrung
itinerary.description: Ascend through bamboo and rhododendron forests, past alpine villages to Namrung, which offers views of Manaslu.

itinerary.title: Trek from Namrung to Lho
itinerary.description: Ascend through forests and farmland past monasteries to Lho, home to Ribung Monastery and stunning Manaslu views.

itinerary.title: Trek from Lho to Samagaun
itinerary.description: Follow the trail through pine forests to Samagaun, a culturally significant village with strong Tibetan influence.

itinerary.title: Acclimatization in Samagaun
itinerary.description: Side trips to Pungyen Gompa, Birendra Lake, or Manaslu Base Camp to help with altitude adaptation.

itinerary.title: Trek from Samagaun to Samdo
itinerary.description: A steady trek to Samdo, a Tibetan refugee village near the border, rich in mountain culture.

itinerary.title: Trek from Samdo to Dharamsala
itinerary.description: Climb steadily toward Dharamsala (Larke Phedi) at the base of the pass, the final rest before the crossing.

itinerary.title: Cross Larke La Pass to Bimthang
itinerary.description: The crowning challenge. Cross the Larke La Pass (5,160m) for breathtaking panoramas before descending to Bimthang.

itinerary.title: Trek from Bimthang to Gao
itinerary.description: Descend through lush forests and meadows to the quiet village of Gao.

itinerary.title: Trek to Tilche and Drive to Bandipur
itinerary.description: Trek to Tilche, then drive to the hilltop Newari village of Bandipur via the Prithvi Highway.

itinerary.title: Drive to Kathmandu
itinerary.description: Drive back to Kathmandu along the Marshyandi and Trishuli rivers. Evening at leisure.

itinerary.title: Departure from Kathmandu
itinerary.description: Transfer to the airport for your international departure.

langtang-valley.title: Langtang Valley Trek
langtang-valley.subtitle: Valley of Glaciers
langtang-valley.overview:
The Langtang Valley Trek is often described as the "Valley of Glaciers" and serves as the closest major Himalayan trekking region to Kathmandu. Despite its proximity to the capital, it remains surprisingly wild and less commercialized than the Everest or Annapurna routes. The journey begins in the lush forests of Langtang National Park—home to the elusive Red Panda—and climbs steadily into vast alpine meadows surrounded by snow-capped giants like Langtang Lirung (7,227m).

The region is culturally distinct, inhabited primarily by the Tamang people whose heritage is deeply rooted in Tibetan Buddhism. As you trek past mani walls and prayer wheels, you witness a community known for its resilience and hospitality, particularly following the recovery from the 2015 earthquake. The trail culminates at Kyanjin Gompa, a spiritual center surrounded by peaks, offering a perfect blend of moderate adventure, stunning biodiversity, and rich culture.

highlights.title: Kyanjin Gompa
highlights.description: Explore the valley's spiritual heart, an ancient monastery.

highlights.title: Kyanjin Ri
highlights.description: Hike to these viewpoints (nearly 5,000m) for spectacular 360-degree panoramas of peaks and glaciers.

highlights.title: Tamang Heritage
highlights.description: Immerse in the unique culture of the Tamang people, with traditions closely linked to Tibet.

highlights.title: Biodiversity
highlights.description: Trek from subtropical forests to alpine scrub, with chances to spot Red Pandas.

highlights.title: Valley of Glaciers
highlights.description: Witness the massive Langtang Lirung glacier system up close.

highlights.title: Easy Accessibility
highlights.description: Reachable by road from Kathmandu, avoiding the need for domestic flights.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kathmandu
itinerary.description: Transfer to your hotel. Evening briefing about the trek.

itinerary.title: Kathmandu Valley Tour
itinerary.description: Visit Pashupatinath and Swayambhunath. Introduction to local culture and spirituality.

itinerary.title: Drive to Syabrubensi
itinerary.description: Drive west along mountain roads to the trailhead at Syabrubensi.

itinerary.title: Syabrubensi to Lama Hotel
itinerary.description: Trek through bamboo and oak forests along the Bhote Koshi river.

itinerary.title: Lama Hotel to Langtang
itinerary.description: Ascend through forests with views of Langtang Lirung appearing above.

itinerary.title: Langtang to Kyanjin Gompa
itinerary.description: Pass large mani walls and chortens to reach the spiritual center of Kyanjin.

itinerary.title: Excursion to Kyanjin Ri
itinerary.description: Hike to Kyanjin Ri (4,773m) for a 360-degree panorama of the massif.

itinerary.title: Kyanjin to Lama Hotel
itinerary.description: Descend back through the valley following the same scenic trail.

itinerary.title: Lama Hotel to Syabrubensi
itinerary.description: Continue the descent to Syabrubensi, walking through rhododendron forests.

itinerary.title: Drive to Kathmandu
itinerary.description: Return drive to the capital. Evening for souvenirs and relaxation.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Transfer to the airport for your flight home.

upper-mustang.title: Upper Mustang Trek
upper-mustang.subtitle: The Last Forbidden Kingdom
upper-mustang.overview:
Mustang, a remote region in northern Nepal, is renowned for its unique culture, stunning landscapes, and ancient monasteries. This high-altitude desert region offers a glimpse into a bygone era, with its well-preserved Tibetan Buddhist traditions and breathtaking scenery. The region is home to the famous Mustang Valley known for its ancient rock paintings and mud-brick villages. Mustang is characterized by its arid, high-altitude landscapes, including deep gorges, barren hills, and towering peaks.

Journey into the “Last Forbidden Kingdom” and explore the walled city of Lo-Manthang. The trek offers a unique blend of adventure and spirituality, characterized by trans-Himalayan desert landscapes, rich Tibetan Buddhist culture, and panoramic views of the Nilgiri, Annapurna, and Dhaulagiri ranges. It is a restricted trekking region, ensuring fewer trekkers and preserving its authenticity and exclusivity.

highlights.title: The Last Forbidden Kingdom
highlights.description: Explore the walled city of Lo-Manthang and its ancient royal palace, forbidden to foreigners until 1992.

highlights.title: Trans-Himalayan Landscapes
highlights.description: Witness unique high-altitude desert scenery with barren cliffs, deep canyons, and dramatic rock formations.

highlights.title: Tibetan Buddhist Culture
highlights.description: Visit centuries-old monasteries, chortens, and mani walls that reflect deep spiritual traditions.

highlights.title: Lo-Manthang Lifestyle
highlights.description: Meet the local Loba people, experience their traditions, and witness vibrant horse culture.

highlights.title: Ancient Caves
highlights.description: Explore mysterious sky caves and sacred sites like Chungsi Cave with ancient murals.

highlights.title: Sacred Monasteries
highlights.description: Visit significant monasteries including Ghar Gompa (8th century) and Tsarang's gold-scripted library.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kathmandu
itinerary.description: Transfer to your hotel. Evening briefing about the trek.

itinerary.title: Kathmandu Valley Tour
itinerary.description: Visit Swayambhunath, Pashupatinath, and Boudhanath Stupa.

itinerary.title: Drive to Pokhara
itinerary.description: A scenic 7-hour drive to the lakeside city of Pokhara.

itinerary.title: Fly to Jomsom, Drive to Kagbeni
itinerary.description: Mountain flight to Jomsom, then drive to Kagbeni, the entry point to Upper Mustang.

itinerary.title: Drive Kagbeni to Ghami
itinerary.description: Drive to Samar, then hike to the sacred Chungsi Cave before reaching Ghami.

itinerary.title: Ghami to Dhakmar Hike
itinerary.description: Hike to Dhakmar, a village beneath stunning red cliffs. Explore nearby caves.

itinerary.title: Hike to Ghar Gompa, Horse ride to Lo-Manthang
itinerary.description: Visit the 8th-century Ghar Gompa, then take a horse ride to the kingdom of Lo-Manthang.

itinerary.title: Explore Lo-Manthang
itinerary.description: Explore the ancient monasteries, the King's palace, and the surrounding canyons.

itinerary.title: Visit Lo-Manthang Monasteries
itinerary.description: Visit God House, Thugchen Gompa, and the sacred murals of Koncholing cave.

itinerary.title: Drive to Jomsom via Tsarang
itinerary.description: Visit the monastery of Tsarang before driving back down to Jomsom.

itinerary.title: Fly back to Pokhara
itinerary.description: Morning flight to Pokhara. Afternoon boating on Phewa Lake.

itinerary.title: Visit Pokhara
itinerary.description: Sunrise at Sarangkot and visit the Mountain Museum.

itinerary.title: Fly to Kathmandu
itinerary.description: Return flight to the capital. Visit historic Ason Market.

itinerary.title: Patan Visit & Tea Tasting
itinerary.description: Explore Patan Durbar Square followed by a Nepalese tea tasting session.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Transfer to the airport for your flight home.

mohare-danda.title: Mohare Danda Trek
mohare-danda.subtitle: Eco-Community Trek
mohare-danda.overview: The Mohare Danda Trek is a spectacular and sustainable journey in the heart of the Annapurna region. This community-led trail offers an authentic alternative to the busy Poon Hill route, taking you through lush rhododendron forests and vibrant Magar villages. Balancing cultural immersion in Kathmandu with high-altitude serenity, the trek culminates at Mohare Ridge, offering hikers intimate homestays and breathtaking vistas of the Dhaulagiri and Annapurna massifs.

highlights.title: 360-Degree Panoramas
highlights.description: Stunning, crowd-free sunrise and sunset views of Dhaulagiri and Annapurna from Mohare Danda (3,313m).

highlights.title: Community-Based Tourism
highlights.description: Support local livelihoods by staying in eco-lodges and authentic Magar village homestays.

highlights.title: Cultural Heritage
highlights.description: Discover three UNESCO World Heritage Sites in the Kathmandu Valley.

highlights.title: Lakeside Relaxation
highlights.description: Enjoy the peaceful atmosphere, boating, and mountain reflections at Phewa Lake in Pokhara.

highlights.title: Social Innovation at Nangi
highlights.description: Visit Nangi Village to learn about social worker Mahabir Pun's pioneering community projects.

highlights.title: Diverse Landscapes
highlights.description: Experience a dramatic transition from tropical orange orchards to high-altitude ridge lines.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kathmandu
itinerary.description: Welcome to Nepal. Transfer to your hotel in Thamel.

itinerary.title: Explore Kathmandu Valley
itinerary.description: Visit Patan, Boudhanath Stupa, and the sacred Pashupatinath Temple.

itinerary.title: Fly to Pokhara
itinerary.description: Morning flight to Pokhara. Afternoon at leisure by the lake.

itinerary.title: Drive to Galeshwor, Hike to Banskharka
itinerary.description: Begin the trek along the Kali Gandaki River through orange orchards.

itinerary.title: Banskharka to Nangi Village
itinerary.description: Trek through pine forests to the model community of Nangi.

itinerary.title: Nangi to Mohare Danda
itinerary.description: Climb through oak forests to the ridge for a 360-degree mountain panorama.

itinerary.title: Mohare Danda to Tikot
itinerary.description: Witness a spectacular sunrise, then descend to the picturesque village of Tikot.

itinerary.title: Tikot to Pokhara
itinerary.description: Scenic descent through terraced fields, then drive back to Pokhara.

itinerary.title: Fly to Kathmandu
itinerary.description: Return flight to the capital. Visit historic Kathmandu Durbar Square.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Transfer to the airport for your international flight.

pilgrimageTrip.title: A Buddhist Pilgrimage
pilgrimageTrip.subtitle: Path of Enlightenment
pilgrimageTrip.overview: This journey traces the sacred path of Buddhism in Nepal, blending cultural discovery with deep spiritual practice. From the birthplace of Lord Buddha in the plains to the ancient stupas of the Kathmandu Valley, this retreat offers a balance of guided meditation, monastic interaction, and historical insight. It is designed for those seeking to understand the essence of the Dharma while experiencing the profound tranquility of Nepal’s most holy sites.

highlights.title: Birthplace of Buddha
highlights.description: Meditate in the Sacred Garden of Lumbini, exactly where Prince Siddhartha was born.

highlights.title: Monastic Life
highlights.description: Stay overnight at a monastery guest house to experience the daily rhythm of monks’ chanting and prayers.

highlights.title: Boudhanath Kora
highlights.description: Join thousands of devotees in the daily ritual circumambulation of the Great Stupa.

highlights.title: Dharma Teachings
highlights.description: Receive an introductory talk on Buddhist philosophy from a resident Lama (teacher).

highlights.title: Namobuddha Visit
highlights.description: Explore the site of "Supreme Generosity," a serene hilltop sacred to the previous life of the Buddha.

itinerary.title: Arrival in the Land of Stupas
itinerary.description: Arrive in Kathmandu and transfer directly to a hotel in the Boudha area, the Tibetan heart of Nepal. In the late afternoon, immerse yourself in the spiritual atmosphere by joining the "Kora" (circumambulation) around the massive Boudhanath Stupa. The air is thick with the scent of incense and the sound of "Om Mani Padme Hum." This ritual walk helps you leave behind the mundane world and enter a sacred space of intention.

itinerary.title: Foundations of the Dharma
itinerary.description: Begin the day with a private meditation session overlooking the stupa. Later, visit the Kopan Monastery or a similar institution for an introduction to Buddhist philosophy and a Dharma talk by a senior monk. You will learn about the Four Noble Truths and the practice of compassion. The afternoon is spent in silent reflection or exploring the artisan workshops around Boudha, where thangka paintings and statues are crafted with meditative precision.

itinerary.title: Pilgrimage to the Birthplace
itinerary.description: Take a morning flight to Bhairahawa and drive to Lumbini, the birthplace of Lord Buddha. Check into a hotel near the Sacred Garden. In the afternoon, visit the Mayadevi Temple and sit in meditation under the Bodhi tree near the sacred pond. This is a powerful location to connect with the roots of Buddhism. The peaceful energy of the gardens provides an ideal setting for contemplation on the impermanence of life.

itinerary.title: Mindfulness in the Monastic Zone
itinerary.description: Dedicate the day to exploring the Lumbini Monastic Zone, which features temples built by Buddhist communities from around the world. We will practice walking meditation between the sites, observing the different architectural interpretations of the Dharma. The afternoon is free for self-guided practice or a discussion on mindfulness techniques. The lack of city noise here allows for a deep "mental detox" and strengthens your focus.

itinerary.title: The Act of Supreme Generosity
itinerary.description: Fly back to Kathmandu and drive to the serene hilltop of Namobuddha. This site is legendary for the story of the Buddha (in a previous life) offering his body to a starving tigress. The energy here is one of overwhelming compassion and selflessness. You will stay at the monastery guest house, eating simple vegetarian meals and witnessing the evening debating or chanting sessions of the young monks.

itinerary.title: Swayambhu and the Primordial Light
itinerary.description: Wake up early to observe the morning puja (prayer ceremony) with the monks at Namobuddha. After breakfast, drive back to Kathmandu to visit Swayambhunath, perched on a hill overlooking the valley. It represents the "self-arisen" wisdom of the Buddha. Explore the complex of shrines and enjoy the sunset over the city. A farewell dinner will be arranged at a traditional restaurant, celebrating the spiritual insights gained.

itinerary.title: Carrying the Dhamma Home
itinerary.description: On your final morning, engage in a closing circle to share experiences and dedicate the merit of your practice to the benefit of all beings. You may have a few hours to purchase prayer flags or beads as reminders of your journey. You will be transferred to the airport, carrying not just souvenirs, but a lighter heart and a set of practical mindfulness tools to integrate into your daily life.

innerPeaceTrip.title: The Path to Inner Peace
innerPeaceTrip.subtitle: Wellness Journey
innerPeaceTrip.overview: This transformative wellness journey in Nepal blends ancient Himalayan spirituality with restorative nature experiences. Designed to realign the mind, body, and spirit, the trip takes you from the energy centers of Kathmandu to the serene lakeside of Pokhara. Through sound healing, monastery visits, and mountain yoga, you will disconnect from daily stress and reconnect with your inner self amidst the world’s highest peaks.

highlights.title: Tibetan Sound Healing
highlights.description: Experience deep vibrational therapy with singing bowls to release tension and align chakras.

highlights.title: Monastery Immersion
highlights.description: Participate in a private meditation session with monks at a hilltop monastery near Boudhanath.

highlights.title: Sunrise Yoga
highlights.description: Practice mindfulness facing the Annapurna range at Sarangkot as the sun illuminates the Himalayas.

highlights.title: Ayurvedic Rejuvenation
highlights.description: Indulge in a traditional massage using herbal oils sourced from the Nepalese highlands.

highlights.title: Peace Pagoda Hike
highlights.description: A silent, meditative walk through the forest to the World Peace Pagoda overlooking Phewa Lake.

itinerary.title: Arrival, transfer to hotel and Vibrational Alignment
itinerary.description: Upon arrival in Kathmandu, you will be transferred to your tranquil hotel away from the city's bustle. The journey begins with a gentle orientation followed by a traditional Tibetan Sound Healing session in the evening. The deep vibrations of the handmade singing bowls will help clear travel fatigue and ground your energy. Enjoy a light, organic vegetarian dinner to prepare your body for the week ahead.

itinerary.title: Spiritual Awakening in Boudhanath Stupa
itinerary.description: Start with a sunrise mindfulness practice before visiting the Boudhanath Stupa, the center of Tibetan Buddhism in Nepal. You will light butter lamps and circumambulate the dome with local pilgrims. In the afternoon, travel to a nearby monastery Kopan for a private guided meditation and a dharma talk on compassion. The day ends with a silent reflection period at your hotel.

itinerary.title: Journey to the Lake City
itinerary.description: Fly to Pokhara, a city renowned for its healing energy and stunning lakes. After checking into your lakeside wellness resort, take a "forest bathing" walk along the shores of Phewa Lake. In the afternoon, enjoy a private boat ride to the Tal Barahi Temple, situated on an island. Use this time to connect with the element of water, allowing the stillness of the lake to calm your mind.

itinerary.title: Mountain Energy and Inner Peace
itinerary.description: Rise early for a drive to Sarangkot for a mignificant sunrise over Annapurna range then back to hotel for yoga session. Afterward, hike silently up to the World Peace Pagoda. This white stupa offers panoramic views and a profound sense of serenity. Spend the afternoon journaling or resting in the resort’s garden.

itinerary.title: Ayurvedic Healing and Grounding
itinerary.description: Today focuses on physical restoration through Ayurveda. After a morning meditation, visit a specialized wellness center for a consultation and a traditional Ayurvedic massage using warm herbal oils. In the afternoon, visit the Gupteshwor Cave to experience the grounding energy of the earth element. The evening is reserved for a "Trataka" (candle gazing) meditation to improve focus and inner clarity before sleep.

itinerary.title: Ancient Roots and Reflection
itinerary.description: Fly back to Kathmandu and travel to the medieval city of Bhaktapur. Walk through its car-free cobblestone streets, observing the slow pace of life and ancient craftsmanship. You will participate in a clay pottery workshop, a grounding activity that connects you tactilely to the earth. In the evening, enjoy a farewell dinner with a traditional cultural performance, celebrating the journey you have undertaken.

itinerary.title: Departure with Gratitude
itinerary.description: Begin your final morning with a gratitude circle and a short closing ceremony to seal the benefits of your practice. Depending on your flight schedule, you may have time for last-minute souvenir shopping for singing bowls or incense. You will be transferred to the airport with a renewed sense of purpose and a "khada" (ceremonial scarf) for safe travels and good fortune.
